P01.rationale: The page features two large, prominent portraits of founders that serve as the dominant human anchors for their respective case studies.

P05.rationale: Each case study clearly frames a named client portrait at a meaningful size (roughly one-third of the column) rather than leaving an empty gap.

P07.rationale: A social-proof apparatus is present in the form of specific data metrics and cost savings figures that function as testimonial evidence.

P10.rationale: There are no oversized decorative typographic elements or giant ghost numerals used to break up the layout.

P11.rationale: The page contains real data-visualisations bound to specific numbers, such as '€200,000' and '90 days', rather than empty chart frames.

P12.rationale: While the top half is dense with content, the bottom section becomes sparse and under-filled with a list of statistics that leaves significant vertical whitespace.

P13.rationale: The background is completely flat blankness (white/off-white) without any intentional texture or atmosphere appropriate to the page type.

P14.rationale: Although not a full-bleed photo, the portraits are treated with a light blue scrim/darkening so that the overlaid text remains readable.

P16.rationale: There is no device or product mockup shown to add real product credibility; only human portraits and abstract data points are used.

N07.rationale: The imagery looks specific to a real business context rather than generic stock photography, as the subjects appear to be actual clients of the firm.

N08.rationale: There is some sparse dead whitespace in the lower third of the page where the list items are spaced out with large gaps between them.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on a busy photo without a scrim; instead, it is overlaid cleanly on top of the portraits and background graphics.
